## File: `references/languages/javascript.md`

### Detection signals — JavaScript/TypeScript (Security: Input & Injection)

Detection signals only. They cite no standard. Report findings against the element IDs listed (defined in
`../standards/`). Node.js parser and framework defaults aren't localized beyond `node-input.md`: report explicit
values only, and add a `localized-standard-gap` note when a decision depends on a default.

| Signal (API, setting or pattern) | Look in | Indicates | Element(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `` db.query(`SELECT … ${req.params.id}`) ``, `"… WHERE id = " + id` with `mysql`/`pg`/`sqlite3`; `sequelize.query(sql)` with interpolation; Knex `raw()` / TypeORM `query()` with interpolation | data access | SQL concatenation | SQL-01, SQL-02, A05-02 |
| `pg` `$1` placeholders, `mysql2` `?` with values array, Sequelize/Prisma/TypeORM query builders | data access | Parameterized access (pass) | QP-01 |
| `collection.find(req.body)`; `{ $where: … }` or operators from input reaching MongoDB | data access | NoSQL operator injection | INJ-06, NDI-02 |
| `child_process.exec`/`execSync` with template strings; `spawn(cmd, { shell: true })` | any | Shell injection | INJ-04, NDI-05 |
| `eval`, `new Function`, `vm.runIn*Context`, `setTimeout(string)` on input | any | Code injection | NDI-05 |
| `element.innerHTML =`, `outerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `document.write`, React `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, Vue `v-html`, Angular `[innerHTML]` / `bypassSecurityTrust*` with untrusted data | front-end files | DOM XSS sinks | XSS-08, XSS-09 |
| EJS `<%- %>`, Handlebars `{{{ }}}`, Pug `!{}` / `!=` on user data | templates | Unescaped output | XSS-02, NDI-04 |
| `express.json({ limit: … })` large or missing on upload-heavy routes; `bodyParser` with `limit: Infinity` | app setup | Unbounded bodies | NDI-01, IV-04 |
| `multer` without `limits.fileSize`/`fileFilter`; `file.originalname` used in a path | upload handlers | Upload checks | FU-01, FU-05, FU-06 |
| `res.redirect(req.query.*)` | handlers | Open redirect | NDI-03 |
| `xml2js`/`libxmljs` with `noent: true` or DTD loading on uploads | XML parsing | XXE | XML-01 |
| `node-serialize` `unserialize`, `serialize-javascript` output passed to `eval`, `js-yaml` `load` with unsafe schema on input | deserialization | Unsafe deserialization | DES-01, DES-02 |
| `new RegExp(req.query.q)`; nested quantifiers on input | any | ReDoS | NDI-06 |

## File: `references/standards/node-input.md`

*Load rule: NDI-01…06. Load when language `javascript` is detected.*

### Node.js / Express input and injection guidance — localized summary

- Applies when language `javascript` is detected and the code runs on Node.js (server code, not browser bundles);
  Express rows need `express` as a dependency. 
- Level: `MUST` where the source says must/must not/never/do not or gives an unqualified imperative; `SHOULD` for
  should/recommended/encouraged/"consider". **(Default)** marks an element that states library behaviour or a default;
  cite the OWASP element that is violated and name this element in the recommendation. Defaults stated here are the
  only Node.js/Express defaults a worker may rely on. Severity rules are in `../../SKILL.md`.

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Code/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| NDI-01 | SHOULD | Request bodies have size limits per content type (`express.json({ limit })`, `express.urlencoded({ limit })`, `raw-body`), and the body is validated against the content type actually parsed. | `express.json()`/`bodyParser.json()` with a raised or unbounded `limit`; parsers registered for any `type` | SEC-II-01 |
| NDI-02 | SHOULD | Input is validated by allowlist before use, with type checks: `req.query`/`req.body` values can be strings, arrays or nested objects (`validator`, schema validators, `express-mongo-sanitize` for MongoDB operators); duplicated parameters are handled (`hpp`). | `req.query.x` used as a string without a type check; `{ $where … }`/`$ne` operators reaching MongoDB queries | SEC-II-01 |
| NDI-03 | MUST | Redirect targets taken from input are checked against an allowlist of hosts before `res.redirect`. | `res.redirect(req.query.url)`; `res.redirect(req.body.next)` | SEC-II-01 |
| NDI-04 | MUST | Output is encoded for its context: `escape-html` covers only HTML text and quoted attributes, not JavaScript, CSS or URL contexts; user HTML is sanitized with DOMPurify or `sanitize-html`; `node-esapi` isn't used. | template output with raw/unescaped tags (`<%- %>`, `{{{ }}}`, `!{}`) on user data; `escape-html` used inside `<script>` or `href` | SEC-II-08 |
| NDI-05 | MUST | `eval()`, `new Function(string)` and `node:vm` aren't used on untrusted input; `child_process.exec` (which runs through a shell) isn't given unvalidated input; file-system paths from input are validated. | `eval(req.body.x)`; `vm.runInNewContext(userCode)`; `` exec(`convert ${req.query.f}`) `` | SEC-II-04 |
| NDI-06 | SHOULD | Regular expressions applied to input avoid nested quantifiers and overlapping alternation (ReDoS); patterns are checked with a safe-regex tool. | `new RegExp(userInput)`; patterns like `(a+)+`, `(\w+\s?)*` on request data | SEC-II-01 |
